Class CareerCentreStaff

java.lang.Object
Models.Entities.User
Models.Entities.CareerCentreStaff
public class CareerCentreStaff extends User
Represents a Career Centre Staff member in the Internship Placement Management System. Staff members have administrative privileges to authorize company representatives, approve internship opportunities, manage withdrawal requests, and generate reports.

Key responsibilities:

  • Authorize or reject company representative registrations
  • Approve or reject internship opportunities
  • Process student withdrawal requests
  • Generate reports with various filters
Since:
2025-11-18

    • approveInternshipOpportunity

      public boolean approveInternshipOpportunity(Internship internship)
      Approves a submitted Internship opportunity. This sets the internship's status to "Approved" and makes it visible to students.
      Parameters:
      internship - The internship to be approved.
      Returns:
      true if the approval was successful; false if the internship is null.

    • approveWithdrawal

      public boolean approveWithdrawal(Application application)
      Approves a student's withdrawal request for an Application. This sets the application status to Application.ApplicationStatus.WITHDRAWN and the withdrawal status to Application.WithdrawalStatus.APPROVED.
      Parameters:
      application - The application whose withdrawal is to be approved.
      Returns:
      true if the approval was successful; false if the application is null.

    • rejectWithdrawal

      public boolean rejectWithdrawal(Application application)
      Rejects a student's withdrawal request for an Application. This sets the withdrawal status to Application.WithdrawalStatus.REJECTED but leaves the application's primary status unchanged.
      Parameters:
      application - The application whose withdrawal is to be rejected.
      Returns:
      true if the rejection was successful; false if the application is null.

    • generateReport

      public void generateReport(List<Internship> allInternships, String filter, int filterType)
      Generates and displays a report of internships filtered by a specified criteria. It uses inherited methods filterInternships and displayInternships from User.
      Parameters:
      allInternships - A list of all available Internship objects.
      filter - The specific value to filter by (e.g., "Approved" for status, "Junior" for level, "IT" for major).
      filterType - The type of filter to apply: 1 for status, 2 for level, 3 for major.
